name: Hands of the Enemy
label: Quest
description: Hands of the Enemy: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Friend, your service is of great value to us, so we are reluctant to send you on this last mission for we do not want to lose such a useful agent.
But its success would further our war efforts tremendously and... It was deemed worth risking you.
We want these captains in the Molten Core destroyed: Lucifron, Sulfuron, Gehennas and Shazzrah. Kill them and bring me their hands!
This task will take every resource you possess, friend, but if can do it then the Firelords will be dealt a terrible blow.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Have you defeated Lucifron and the others, friend? Do you have the hands of the enemy?

clips.title: Completion
paras: You have the hands! You defeated the fire captains! I would not have thought it possible, had I not known you and what you are capable of.
Friend, your exploits are without number, but word of this last feat will send waves among the Waterlords. Your name may one day be legend to us.
Speak with me again, friend. I may have yet another task...
